name: demo script, romanised Hindi
transcript: Okay, quick sync on the clinic rollout. Weather's been crazy, by the way. Tell me about it. So where are we on the patient intake form? I'll send you the revised intake form by Friday evening. Great. Maybe we should also think about a WhatsApp reminder someday. Haan, aur pharmacy wale data ka kya? Main kal tak pharmacy ka stock report bhej dunga. Perfect. And Alex already fixed the printer last week. One more thing — can you book the training room for Monday? Yes, I'll book the training room for Monday morning today itself.
